name: CloudWalk Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: CloudWalk Technology Co., Ltd. provides human-machine collaborative operating systems and artificial intelligence solutions in China. It offers intelligent devices, such as edge computing equipment, large model, training and inference all-in-one machine, face recognition terminal, binocular structured light module, network camera, and smart container, as well as VisionCloud, a data management platform.
